titre: Bulgaria joins NATO lower-level air defence threat initiative

titre: US FCC plans vote to block Chinese telecoms from US telephone numbers
resume: The US Federal Communications Commission scheduled a vote for November 19 to bar China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom from direct access to US phone numbers. Regulators cited national security risks associated with interconnected telecommunications networks.
